definition.name: Snap Lines to Shared Corner Points
definition.description: Moves the ends of given model lines/arcs to the nearest of a set of shared E/N corner points, keeping arc bulges.
definition.aiDescription: Moves the ends of given model lines/arcs to the nearest of a set of shared E/N corner points, keeping arc bulges.
examples: adjust the setback lines to 4 m and 8 m from the plot
snap these lines to the corrected corners
